_about: Colour tokens for everything the game draws, from Mofid Brand Book v0.4 pages 8-9 (primary and secondary colours with the tints printed under them) and the neutrals used in its layouts (pages 22-24). Change a value here and restart the game: shapes drawn in code use it directly, and the 'themed' SVGs in manifest.json are recoloured from the default value to the new one. The logos are never recoloured. See documentation/design-system.md before changing anything: the brand book limits where each colour may be used.
